note: Verse text only; Psalms are numbered as in the Gitsawe (Ethiopian/Septuagint).

PSA 68:9-m: የቤትህ ቅንዓት በልታኛለችና፥ የሚሰድቡህም ስድብ በላዬ ወድቆአልና።
For the zeal of your house consumes me. The reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.
When I wept and I fasted, that was to my reproach.
LUK 9:52-56: በፊቱም መልክተኞችን ሰደደ። ሄደውም ሊያሰናዱለት ወደ አንድ ወደ ሳምራውያን መንደር ገቡ፤
and sent messengers before his face. They went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, so as to prepare for him.
ፊቱም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እንደሚሄድ ስለ ነበረ አልተቀበሉትም።
They didn’t receive him, because he was traveling with his face set towards Jerusalem.
ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ያዕቆብና ዮሐንስ አይተው። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ኤልያስ ደግሞ እንዳደረገ እሳት ከሰማይ ወርዶ ያጥፋቸው እንል ዘንድ ትወዳለህን? አሉት።
When his disciples, James and John, saw this, they said, “Lord, do you want us to command fire to come down from the sky, and destroy them, just as Elijah did?”
እርሱ ግን ዘወር ብሎ ገሠጻቸውና። ምን ዓይነት መንፈስ እንደ ሆነላችሁ አታውቁም፤
But he turned and rebuked them, “You don’t know of what kind of spirit you are.
የሰው ልጅ የሰውን ነፍስ ሊያድን እንጂ ሊያጠፋ አልመጣም አለ። ወደ ሌላ መንደርም ሄዱ።
For the Son of Man didn’t come to destroy men’s lives, but to save them.” They went to another village.
ROM 11:1-13: እንግዲህ። እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን ጣላቸውን? እላለሁ። አይደለም እኔ ደግሞ እስራኤላዊና ከአብርሃም ዘር ከብንያምም ወገን ነኝና።
I ask then, did God reject his people? May it never be! For I also am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.
እግዚአብሔር አስቀድሞ ያወቃቸውን ሕዝብ አልጣላቸውም። መጽሐፍ ስለ ኤልያስ በተጻፈው የሚለውን፥ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እስራኤልን እንዴት እንደሚከስ፥ አታውቁምን?
God didn’t reject his people, which he foreknew. Or don’t you know what the Scripture says about Elijah? How he pleads with God against Israel:
ጌታ ሆይ፥ ነቢያትህን ገደሉ መሠዊያዎችህንም አፈረሱ እኔም ብቻዬን ቀረሁ ነፍሴንም ይሹአታል።
“Lord, they have killed your prophets, they have broken down your altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.”
ነገር ግን አምላካዊ መልስ ምን አለው? ለበአል ያልሰገዱትን ሰባት ሺህ ሰዎች ለእኔ አስቀርቼአለሁ።
But how does God answer him? “I have reserved for myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to Baal.”
እንደዚሁም በአሁን ዘመን ደግሞ በጸጋ የተመረጡ ቅሬታዎች አሉ።
Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.
በጸጋ ከሆነ ግን ከሥራ መሆኑ ቀርቶአል፤ ጸጋ ያለዚያ ጸጋ መሆኑ ቀርቶአል።
And if by grace, then it is no longer of works; otherwise grace is no longer grace. But if it is of works, it is no longer grace; otherwise work is no longer work.
እንግዲህ ምንድር ነው? እስራኤል የሚፈልጉትን አላገኙትም፤ የተመረጡት ግን አገኙት፤
What then? That which Israel seeks for, that he didn’t obtain, but the chosen ones obtained it, and the rest were hardened.
ሌሎቹም ደነዘዙ፤ እንዲሁም። ዓይኖቻቸው እንዳያዩ ጆሮቻቸውም እንዳይሰሙ እግዚአብሔር የእንቅልፍ መንፈስን እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ሰጣቸው ተብሎ ተጽፎአል። ዳዊትም።
According as it is written, “God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear, to this very day.”
ማዕዳቸው ወጥመድና አሽክላ ማሰናከያም ፍዳም ይሁንባቸው፤
David says, “Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, a stumbling block, and a retribution to them.
ዓይኖቻቸው እንዳያዩ ይጨልሙ፥ ጀርባቸውንም ዘወትር አጉብጥ ብሎአል።
Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see. Bow down their back always.”
እንግዲህ። የተሰናከሉ እስኪወድቁ ድረስ ነውን? እላለሁ። አይደለም፤ ነገር ግን እነርሱን ያስቀናቸው ዘንድ በእነርሱ በደል መዳን ለአሕዛብ ሆነ።
I ask then, did they stumble that they might fall? May it never be! But by their fall salvation has come to the Gentiles, to provoke them to jealousy.
ዳሩ ግን በደላቸው ለዓለም ባለ ጠግነት መሸነፋቸውም ለአሕዛብ ባለ ጠግነት ከሆነ፥ ይልቁንስ መሙላታቸው እንዴት ይሆን?
Now if their fall is the riches of the world, and their loss the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fullness?
ለእናንተም ለአሕዛብ እናገራለሁ። እኔ የአሕዛብ ሐዋርያ በሆንሁ መጠን ሥጋዬ የሆኑትን አስቀንቼ ምናልባት ከእነርሱ አንዳንዱን አድን እንደሆነ አገልግሎቴን አከብራለሁ።
For I speak to you who are Gentiles. Since then as I am an apostle to Gentiles, I glorify my ministry;
JAS 5:16-EOC: እርስ በርሳችሁ በኃጢአታችሁ ተናዘዙ። ትፈወሱም ዘንድ እያንዳንዱ ስለ ሌላው ይጸልይ፤ የጻድቅ ሰው ጸሎት በሥራዋ እጅግ ኃይል ታደርጋለች።
Confess your offenses to one another, and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The insistent prayer of a righteous person is powerfully effective.
ኤልያስ እንደ እኛ የሆነ ሰው ነበረ፥ ዝናብም እንዳይዘንብ አጥብቆ ጸለየ፥ በምድርም ላይ ሦስት ዓመት ከስድስት ወር አልዘነበም፤ ሁለተኛም ጸለየ፥
Elijah was a man with a nature like ours, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain, and it didn’t rain on the earth for three years and six months.
ሰማዩም ዝናብን ሰጠ ምድሪቱም ፍሬዋን አበቀለች።
He prayed again, and the sky gave rain, and the earth produced its fruit.
ወንድሞቼ ሆይ፥ ከእናንተ ማንም ከእውነት ቢስት አንዱም ቢመልሰው፥
Brothers, if any among you wanders from the truth and someone turns him back,
ኃጢአተኛን ከተሳሳተበት መንገድ የሚመልሰው ነፍሱን ከሞት እንዲያድን፥ የኃጢአትንም ብዛት እንዲሸፍን ይወቅ።
let him know that he who turns a sinner from the error of his way will save a soul from death and will cover a multitude of sins.
ACT 3:19-EOC: እንግዲህ ከጌታ ፊት የመጽናናት ዘመን እንድትመጣላችሁ አስቀድሞም ለእናንተ የመረጠውን ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን እንዲልክላችሁ፥ ኃጢአታችሁ ይደመሰስ ዘንድ ንስሐ ግቡ ተመለሱም።
“Repent therefore, and turn again, that your sins may be blotted out, so that there may come times of refreshing from the presence of the Lord,
and that he may send Christ Jesus, who was ordained for you before,
እግዚአብሔር ከጥንት ጀምሮ በቅዱሳን ነቢያቱ አፍ የተናገረው፥ ነገር ሁሉ እስከሚታደስበት ዘመን ድረስ ሰማይ ይቀበለው ዘንድ ይገባልና።
whom heaven must receive until the times of restoration of all things, which God spoke long ago by the mouth of his holy prophets.
ሙሴም ለአባቶች። ጌታ አምላክ እኔን እንዳስነሣኝ ነቢይን ከወንድሞቻችሁ ያስነሣላችኋል፤ በሚነግራችሁ ሁሉ እርሱን ስሙት።
For Moses indeed said to the fathers, ‘The Lord God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him in all things whatever he says to you.
ያንም ነቢይ የማትሰማው ነፍስ ሁሉ ከሕዝብ ተለይታ ትጠፋለች አለ።
It will be that every soul that will not listen to that prophet will be utterly destroyed from among the people.’
ሁለተኛም ከሳሙኤል ጀምሮ ከእርሱም በኋላ የተናገሩት ነቢያት ሁሉ ደግሞ ስለዚህ ወራት ተናገሩ።
Yes, and all the prophets from Samuel and those who followed after, as many as have spoken, they also told of these days.
እናንተ የነቢያት ልጆችና እግዚአብሔር ለአብርሃም። በዘርህ የምድር ወገኖች ሁሉ ይባረካሉ ብሎ፥ ከአባቶቻችን ጋር ያደረገው የኪዳን ልጆች ናችሁ።
You are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying to Abraham, ‘In your offspring will all the families of the earth be blessed.’
ለእናንተ አስቀድሞ እግዚአብሔር ብላቴናውን አስነሥቶ፥ እያንዳንዳችሁን ከክፋታችሁ እየመለሰ ይባርካችሁ ዘንድ፥ ሰደደው።
God, having raised up his servant Jesus, sent him to you first to bless you, in turning away every one of you from your wickedness.”
PSA 104:14-m: የቀባኋቸውን አትዳስሱ፥ በነቢያቴም ክፉ አታድርጉ ብሎ፥ ሰው ግፍ ያደርግባቸው ዘንድ አልፈቀደም፥ ስለ እነርሱም ነገሥታትን ገሠጸ።
He allowed no one to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,
“Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”
LUK 4:25-30: ነገር ግን እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ በኤልያስ ዘመን ሦስት ዓመት ከስድስት ወር ሰማይ ተዘግቶ ሳለ በምድር ሁሉ ብርቱ ራብ በነበረ ጊዜ፥ በእስራኤል ብዙ መበለቶች ነበሩ፤
But truly I tell you, there were many widows in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the sky was shut up three years and six months, when a great famine came over all the land.
ኤልያስም በሲዶና አገር ወዳለች ወደ ሰራፕታ ወደ አንዲት መበለት እንጂ ከእነርሱ ወደ አንዲቱ አልተላከም።
Elijah was sent to none of them, except to Zarephath, in the land of Sidon, to a woman who was a widow.
በነቢዩ በኤልሳዕ ዘመንም በእስራኤል ብዙ ለምጻሞች ነበሩ፥ ከሶርያዊው ከንዕማን በቀር ከእነርሱ አንድ ስንኳ አልነጻም።
There were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet, yet not one of them was cleansed, except Naaman, the Syrian.”
በምኵራብም የነበሩ ሁሉ ይህን ሰምተው ቍጣ ሞላባቸው፥ ተነሥተውም ከከተማ ወደ ውጭ አወጡት፥
They were all filled with wrath in the synagogue, as they heard these things.
ይጥሉትም ዘንድ ከተማቸው ተሠርታባት ወደ ነበረች ወደ ተራራው አፋፍ ወሰዱት፤
They rose up, threw him out of the city, and led him to the brow of the hill that their city was built on, that they might throw him off the cliff.
But he, passing through the middle of them, went his way.
PSA 9:1-m: አቤቱ፥ በልቤ ሁሉ አመሰግንሃለሁ፥ ተአምራትህንም ሁሉ እነግራለሁ።
I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.

እሴይም ንጉሥ ዳዊትን ወለደ።
Jesse became the father of King David. David became the father of Solomon by her who had been Uriah’s wife.
ሰሎሞንም ሮብዓምን ወለደ፤ ሮብዓምም አቢያን ወለደ፤ አቢያም አሣፍን ወለደ፤

ያመኑትም ሕዝብ አንድ ልብ አንዲትም ነፍስ ነበሩአቸው፥ ገንዘባቸውም ሁሉ በአንድነት ነበረ እንጂ ካለው አንድ ነገር ስንኳ የራሱ እንደ ሆነ ማንም አልተናገረም።
The multitude of those who believed were of one heart and soul. Not one of them claimed that anything of the things which he possessed was his own, but they had all things in common.
ሐዋርያትም የጌታን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን ትንሣኤ በታላቅ ኃይል ይመሰክሩ ነበር፤ በሁሉም ላይ ታላቅ ጸጋ ነበረባቸው።
With great power, the apostles gave their testimony of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. Great grace was on them all.
በመካከላቸው አንድ ስንኳ ችግረኛ አልነበረምና፤ መሬት ወይም ቤት ያላቸው ሁሉ እየሸጡ የተሸጠውን ዋጋ ያመጡ ነበርና፥
For neither was there among them any who lacked, for as many as were owners of lands or houses sold them, and brought the proceeds of the things that were sold,
በሐዋርያትም እግር አጠገብ ያኖሩ ነበር፤ ማናቸውም እንደሚፈልግ መጠን ለእያንዳንዱ ያካፍሉት ነበር።
and laid them at the apostles’ feet, and distribution was made to each, according as anyone had need.
ትውልዱም የቆጵሮስ ሰው የነበረ አንድ ሌዋዊ ዮሴፍ የሚሉት ነበረ፥ እርሱም በሐዋርያት በርናባስ ተባለ ትርጓሜውም የመጽናናት ልጅ ነው፤
Joses, who by the apostles was also called Barnabas (which is, being interpreted, Son of Encouragement), a Levite, a man of Cyprus by race,
እርሻም ነበረውና ሽጦ ገንዘቡን አምጥቶ ከሐዋርያት እግር አጠገብ አኖረው።
having a field, sold it, and brought the money and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
PSA 105:18-m: በማኅበራቸውም እሳት ነደደች፥ ነበልባልም ኅጥኣንን አቃጠላቸው።
A fire was kindled in their company. The flame burned up the wicked.
በኮሬብም ጥጃን ሠሩ፥ ቀልጦ ለተሠራ ምስልም ሰገዱ።
They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped a molten image.
PSA 38:7-m: አሁንስ ተስፋዬ ማን ነው? እግዚአብሔር አይደለምን? ትዕግሥቴም ከአንተ ዘንድ ነው።
Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.
ከኃጢአቴ ሁሉ አድነኝ፥ ለሰነፎችም ስድብ አታድርገኝ።
Deliver me from all my transgressions. Don’t make me the reproach of the foolish.
MAT 5:33-EOC: ደግሞ ለቀደሙት። በውሸት አትማል ነገር ግን መሐላዎችህን ለጌታ ስጥ እንደተባለ ሰምታችኋል።
“Again you have heard that it was said to them of old time, ‘You shall not make false vows, but shall perform to the Lord your vows,’
እኔ ግን እላችኋለሁ። ከቶ አትማሉ፤ በሰማይ አይሆንም የእግዚአብሔር ዙፋን ነውና፤
but I tell you, don’t swear at all: neither by heaven, for it is the throne of God;
በምድርም አይሆንም የእግሩ መረገጫ ናትና፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም አይሆንም የታላቁ ንጉሥ ከተማ ናትና፤
nor by the earth, for it is the footstool of his feet; nor by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.
በራስህም አትማል፥ አንዲቱን ጠጉር ነጭ ወይም ጥቁር ልታደርግ አትችልምና።
Neither shall you swear by your head, for you can’t make one hair white or black.
ነገር ግን ቃላችሁ አዎን አዎን ወይም አይደለም አይደለም ይሁን፤ ከነዚህም የወጣ ከክፉው ነው።
But let your ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes’ and your ‘No’ be ‘No.’ Whatever is more than these is of the evil one.
ዓይን ስለ ዓይን ጥርስም ስለ ጥርስ እንደ ተባለ ሰምታችኋል።
“You have heard that it was said, ‘An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.’
እኔ ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ ክፉውን አትቃወሙ፤ ዳሩ ግን ቀኝ ጉንጭህን በጥፊ ለሚመታህ ሁሉ ሁለተኛውን ደግሞ አዙርለት፤
But I tell you, don’t resist him who is evil; but whoever strikes you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also.
እንዲከስህም እጀ ጠባብህንም እንዲወስድ ለሚወድ መጎናጸፊያህን ደግሞ ተውለት፤
If anyone sues you to take away your coat, let him have your cloak also.
ማንም ሰው አንድ ምዕራፍ ትሄድ ዘንድ ቢያስገድድህ ሁለተኛውን ከእርሱ ጋር ሂድ።
Whoever compels you to go one mile, go with him two.
ለሚለምንህ ስጥ፥ ከአንተም ይበደር ዘንድ ከሚወደው ፈቀቅ አትበል።
Give to him who asks you, and don’t turn away him who desires to borrow from you.
ባልንጀራህን ውደድ ጠላትህንም ጥላ እንደ ተባለ ሰምታችኋል።
“You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’
እኔ ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ በሰማያት ላለ አባታችሁ ልጆች ትሆኑ ዘንድ ጠላቶቻችሁን ውደዱ፥ የሚረግሙአችሁንም መርቁ፥ ለሚጠሉአችሁም መልካም አድርጉ፥ ስለሚያሳድዱአችሁም ጸልዩ፤ እርሱ በክፎዎችና በበጎዎች ላይ ፀሐይን ያወጣልና፥ በጻድቃንና በኃጢአተኞችም ላይ ዝናቡን ያዘንባልና።
But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat you and persecute you,
that you may be children of your Father who is in heaven. For he makes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the just and the unjust.
የሚወዱአችሁን ብትወዱ ምን ዋጋ አላችሁ? ቀራጮችስ ያንኑ ያደርጉ የለምን?
For if you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?
ወንድሞቻችሁንም ብቻ እጅ ብትነሡ ምን ብልጫ ታደርጋላችሁ? አሕዛብስ ያንኑ ያደርጉ የለምን?
If you only greet your friends, what more do you do than others? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?
እንግዲህ የሰማዩ አባታችሁ ፍጹም እንደ ሆነ እናንተ ፍጹማን ሁኑ።
Therefore you shall be perfect, just as your Father in heaven is perfect.
ROM 10:12-EOC: በአይሁዳዊና በግሪክ ሰው መካከል ልዩነት የለምና፤ አንዱ ጌታ የሁሉ ጌታ ነውና፥ ለሚጠሩትም ሁሉ ባለ ጠጋ ነው፤
For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek; for the same Lord is Lord of all, and is rich to all who call on him.
የጌታን ስም የሚጠራ ሁሉ ይድናልና።
For, “Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.”
እንግዲህ ያላመኑበትን እንዴት አድርገው ይጠሩታል? ባልሰሙትስ እንዴት ያምናሉ? ያለ ሰባኪስ እንዴት ይሰማሉ?
How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? How will they believe in him whom they have not heard? How will they hear without a preacher?
መልካሙን የምሥራች የሚያወሩ እግሮቻቸው እንዴት ያማሩ ናቸው ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ ካልተላኩ እንዴት ይሰብካሉ?
And how will they preach unless they are sent? As it is written: “How beautiful are the feet of those who preach the Good News of peace, who bring glad tidings of good things!”
ነገር ግን ሁሉ ለምሥራቹ ቃል አልታዘዙም። ኢሳይያስ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ምስክርነታችንን ማን አመነ? ብሎአልና።
But they didn’t all listen to the glad news. For Isaiah says, “Lord, who has believed our report?”
እንግዲያስ እምነት ከመስማት ነው መስማትም በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ነው።
So faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
ዳሩ ግን። ባይሰሙ ነው ወይ? እላለሁ። በእውነት። ድምፃቸው በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ቃላቸውም እስከ ዓለም ዳርቻ ወጣ።
But I say, didn’t they hear? Yes, most certainly, “Their sound went out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world.”
ነገር ግን። እስራኤል ባያውቁ ነው ወይ? እላለሁ። ሙሴ አስቀድሞ። እኔ ሕዝብ በማይሆነው አስቀናችኋለሁ በማያስተውልም ሕዝብ አስቆጣችኋለሁ
But I ask, didn’t Israel know? First Moses says, “I will provoke you to jealousy with that which is no nation, with a nation void of understanding I will make you angry.”
ብሎአል። ኢሳይያስም ደፍሮ። ላልፈለጉኝ ተገኘሁ፥ ላልጠየቁኝም ተገለጥሁ አለ።
Isaiah is very bold, and says, “I was found by those who didn’t seek me. I was revealed to those who didn’t ask for me.”
ስለ እስራኤል ግን። ቀኑን ሁሉ ወደማይታዘዝና ወደሚቃወም ሕዝብ እጆቼን ዘረጋሁ ይላል።
But as to Israel he says, “All day long I stretched out my hands to a disobedient and contrary people.”
GAL 3:21-EOC: እንግዲህ ሕግ የእግዚአብሔርን የተስፋ ቃል የሚቃወም ነውን? አይደለም። ሕያው ሊያደርግ የሚቻለው ሕግ ተሰጥቶ ቢሆንስ በእውነት ጽድቅ ከሕግ በሆነ ነበር፤
Is the law then against the promises of God? Certainly not! For if there had been a law given which could make alive, most certainly righteousness would have been of the law.
ነገር ግን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ከማመን የሆነው የተስፋ ቃል ለሚያምኑ ይሰጥ ዘንድ መጽሐፍ ከኃጢአት በታች ሁሉን ዘግቶታል።
But the Scriptures imprisoned all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.
እምነትም ሳይመጣ ሊገለጥ ላለው እምነት ተዘግተን ከሕግ በታች እንጠበቅ ነበር።
But before faith came, we were kept in custody under the law, confined for the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
እንደዚህ በእምነት እንጸድቅ ዘንድ ሕግ ወደ ክርስቶስ የሚያመጣ ሞግዚታችን ሆኖአል፤
So that the law has become our tutor to bring us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
እምነት ግን መጥቶአልና ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ከሞግዚት በታች አይደለንም።
But now that faith has come, we are no longer under a tutor.
በእምነት በኩል ሁላችሁ በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች ናችሁና፤
For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.

ነገር ግን ሰሎሞን ቤት ሠራለት።
But Solomon built him a house.
ነገር ግን ነቢዩ። ሰማይ ዙፋኔ ነው ምድርም የእግሬ መረገጫ ናት፤ ለእኔ ምን ዓይነት ቤት ትሠራላችሁ? ይላል ጌታ፥ ወይስ የማርፍበት ስፍራ ምንድር ነው? ይህንስ ሁሉ እጄ የሠራችው አይደለምን? እንዳለ፥ ልዑል የሰው እጅ በሠራችው አይኖርም።
However, the Most High doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands, as the prophet says,
‘heaven is my throne, and the earth a footstool for my feet. What kind of house will you build me?’ says the Lord. ‘Or what is the place of my rest?
Didn’t my hand make all these things?’
እናንተ አንገተ ደንዳኖች ልባችሁና ጆሮአችሁም ያልተገረዘ፥ እናንተ ሁልጊዜ መንፈስ ቅዱስን ትቃወማላችሁ፤ አባቶቻችሁ እንደ ተቃወሙት እናንተ ደግሞ።
“You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit! As your fathers did, so you do.
ከነቢያትስ አባቶቻችሁ ያላሳደዱት ማን ነው? የጻድቁንም መምጣት አስቀድሞ የተናገሩትን ገደሉአቸው፤ በመላእክት ሥርዓት ሕግን ተቀብላችሁ ያልጠበቃችሁት እናንተም አሁን እርሱን አሳልፋችሁ ሰጣችሁት ገደላችሁትም።
Which of the prophets didn’t your fathers persecute? They killed those who foretold the coming of the Righteous One, of whom you have now become betrayers and murderers.
You received the law as it was ordained by angels, and didn’t keep it!”
ይህንም በሰሙ ጊዜ በልባቸው በጣም ተቈጡ ጥርሳቸውንም አፋጩበት።
Now when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth.
መንፈስ ቅዱስንም ተሞልቶ ወደ ሰማይ ትኵር ብሎ ሲመለከት የእግዚአብሔርን ክብር ኢየሱስንም በእግዚአብሔር ቀኝ ቆሞ አየና።
But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, looked up steadfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,
እነሆ፥ ሰማያት ተከፍተው የሰው ልጅም በእግዚአብሔር ቀኝ ቆሞ አያለሁ አለ።
and said, “Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God!”
በታላቅ ድምፅም እየጮኹ ጆሮአቸውን ደፈኑ፥ በአንድ ልብ ሆነውም ወደ እርሱ ሮጡ፥
But they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and rushed at him with one accord.
ከከተማም ወደ ውጭ አውጥተው ወገሩት። ምስክሮችም ልብሳቸውን ሳውል በሚሉት በአንድ ጎበዝ እግር አጠገብ አኖሩ።
They threw him out of the city, and stoned him. The witnesses placed their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.
እስጢፋኖስም። ጌታ ኢየሱስ ሆይ፥ ነፍሴን ተቀበል ብሎ ሲጠራ ይወግሩት ነበር።
They stoned Stephen as he called out, saying, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit!”
ተንበርክኮም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ይህን ኃጢአት አትቍጠርባቸው ብሎ በታላቅ ድምፅ ጮኸ። ይህንም ብሎ አንቀላፋ። ሳውልም በእርሱ መገደል ተስማምቶ ነበር።
He kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, “Lord, don’t hold this sin against them!” When he had said this, he fell asleep.
PSA 106:29-m: ዐውሎንም ጸጥ አደረገ፥ ሞገዱም ዝም አለ።
He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.
ዝም ብሎአልና ደስ አላቸው፤ ወደ ፈለጉትም ወደብ መራቸው።
Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.
PSA 93:6-m: ባልቴቲቱንና ድሀ አደጉን ገደሉ፥ ስደተኛውንም ገደሉ።
They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.
እግዚአብሔር አያይም፥ የያዕቆብ አምላክ አያስተውልም አሉ።
They say, “Yah will not see, neither will Jacob’s God consider.”
MRK 7:25-31: ወዲያው ግን ታናሺቱ ልጅዋ ርኵስ መንፈስ ያደረባት አንዲት ሴት ስለ እርሱ ሰምታ መጣችና በእግሩ ላይ ተደፋች
For a woman, whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having heard of him, came and fell down at his feet.
ሴቲቱም ግሪክ፥ ትውልድዋም ሲሮፊኒቃዊት ነበረች፤ ከልጅዋ ጋኔን ያወጣላት ዘንድ ለመነችው።
Now the woman was a Greek, a Syrophoenician by race. She begged him that he would cast the demon out of her daughter.
ኢየሱስ ግን። ልጆቹ በፊት ይጠግቡ ዘንድ ተዪ የልጆቹን እንጀራ ይዞ ለቡችሎች መጣል አይገባምናአላት።
But Jesus said to her, “Let the children be filled first, for it is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”
እርስዋም መልሳ። አዎን፥ ጌታ ሆይ፥ ቡችሎች እንኳ ከማዕድ በታች ሆነው የልጆችን ፍርፋሪ ይበላሉ አለችው።
But she answered him, “Yes, Lord. Yet even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.”
እርሱም። ስለዚህ ቃልሽ ሂጂ ጋኔኑ ከልጅሽ ወጥቶአል አላት።
He said to her, “For this saying, go your way. The demon has gone out of your daughter.”
ወደ ቤትዋም ሄዳ ጋኔኑ ወጥቶ ልጅዋም በአልጋ ላይ ተኝታ አገኘች።
She went away to her house, and found the child having been laid on the bed, with the demon gone out.
ደግሞም ከጢሮስ አገር ወጥቶ በሲዶና አልፎ አሥር ከተማ በሚባል አገር መካከል ወደ ገሊላ ባሕር መጣ።
Again he departed from the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and came to the sea of Galilee, through the middle of the region of Decapolis.
PSA 138:13-m: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ኵላሊቴን ፈጥረሃልና፥ በእናቴም ሆድ ሰውረኸኛል።
For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my mother’s womb.
ግሩምና ድንቅ ሆኜ ተፈጥሬአለሁና አመሰግንሃለሁ፤ ሥራህ ድንቅ ነው፥ ነፍሴም እጅግ ታውቀዋለች።
I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.
JHN 5:36-m: እኔ ግን ከዮሐንስ ምስክር የሚበልጥ ምስክር አለኝ፤ አብ ልፈጽመው የሰጠኝ ሥራ፥ ይህ የማደርገው ሥራ፥ አብ እንደ ላከኝ ስለ እኔ ይመሰክራልና።
But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John, for the works which the Father gave me to accomplish, the very works that I do, testify about me, that the Father has sent me.
የላከኝ አብም እርሱ ስለ እኔ መስክሮአል። ድምፁን ከቶ አልሰማችሁም፥ መልኩንም አላያችሁም፤
The Father himself, who sent me, has testified about me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.
TIT 1:5-12: ስለዚህ ምክንያት የቀረውን እንድታደራጅ በየከተማውም፥ እኔ አንተን እንዳዘዝሁ፥ ሽማግሌዎችን እንድትሾም በቀርጤስ ተውሁህ፤
I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking, and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you;
የማይነቀፍና የአንዲት ሚስት ባል የሚሆን፥ የሚያምኑም ልጆች ያሉት፥ ስለ መዳራትም ወይም ስለ አለመታዘዝ የማይከሰስ ማንም ቢኖር፥ ሹመው።
if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior.
ኤጲስ ቆጶስ፥ እንደ እግዚአብሔር መጋቢ፥ የማይነቀፍ ሊሆን ይገባዋልና፤ የማይኮራ፥ የማይቆጣ፥ የማይሰክር፥ የማይጨቃጨቅ፥ ነውረኛ ረብ የማይወድ፥
For the overseer must be blameless, as God’s steward; not self-pleasing, not easily angered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for dishonest gain;
ነገር ግን እንግዳ ተቀባይ፥ በጎ የሆነውን ነገር የሚወድ፥ ጠንቃቃ፥ ጻድቅ፥ ቅዱስ፥ ራሱን የሚገዛ ይሁን፤
but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober minded, fair, holy, self-controlled;
ሕይወት በሚገኝበት ትምህርት ደግሞ ሊመክር ተቃዋሚዎቹንም ሊወቅስ ይችል ዘንድ፥ እንደተማረው በታመነ ቃል ይጽና።
holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict those who contradict him.
የማይታዘዙና ከንቱ የሚናገሩ የሚያታልሉ ይልቁንም ከተገረዙት ወገን የሚሆኑ ብዙ ናቸውና፤
For there are also many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,
እነዚህም ስለ ነውረኛ ረብ የማይገባውን እያስተማሩ ቤቶችን በሞላው ስለ ሚገለብጡ፥ አፋቸውን መዝጋት ይገባል።
whose mouths must be stopped; men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for dishonest gain’s sake.
የገዛ ራሳቸው ነቢይ የሆነ ከእነርሱ አንዱ። የቀርጤስ ሰዎች ዘወትር ውሸተኞች፥ ክፉዎች አራዊት፥ በላተኞች፥ ሥራ ፈቶች ናቸው ብሎአል።
One of them, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, and idle gluttons.”
1CO 9:1-15: እኔ ነጻ አይደለሁምን? ሐዋርያስ አይደለሁምን? ጌታችንን ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስንስ አላየሁትምን? እናንተስ በጌታ ሥራዬ አይደላችሁምን?
Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Haven’t I seen Jesus Christ, our Lord? Aren’t you my work in the Lord?
የሐዋርያነቴ ማኅተም በጌታ እናንተ ናችሁና ለሌሎች ሐዋርያ ባልሆን ለእናንተስ ምንም ቢሆን ሐዋርያ ነኝ።
If to others I am not an apostle, yet at least I am to you; for you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.
ለሚመረምሩኝ መልሴ ይህ ነው። ልንበላና ልንጠጣ መብት የለንምን?
My defense to those who examine me is this.
Have we no right to eat and to drink?
እንደ ሌሎቹ ሐዋርያትና እንደ ጌታ ወንድሞች እንደ ኬፋም፥ እኅት ሚስታችንን ይዘን ልንዞር መብት የለንምን?
Have we no right to take along a wife who is a believer, even as the rest of the apostles, and the brothers of the Lord, and Cephas?

“Don’t lay up treasures for yourselves on the earth, where moth and rust consume, and where thieves break through and steal;

but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust consume, and where thieves don’t break through and steal;
መዝገብህ ባለበት ልብህ ደግሞ በዚያ ይሆናልና።
for where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
የሰውነት መብራት ዓይን ናት። ዓይንህ እንግዲህ ጤናማ ብትሆን፥ ሰውነትህ ሁሉ ብሩህ ይሆናል፤
“The lamp of the body is the eye. If therefore your eye is sound, your whole body will be full of light.
ዓይንህ ግን ታማሚ ብትሆን፥ ሰውነትህ ሁሉ የጨለመ ይሆናል። እንግዲህ በአንተ ያለው ብርሃን ጨለማ ከሆነ፥ ጨለማውስ እንዴት ይበረታ!
But if your eye is evil, your whole body will be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in you is darkness, how great is the darkness!
ለሁለት ጌቶች መገዛት የሚቻለው ማንም የለም፤ ወይም አንዱን ይጠላል ሁለተኛውንም ይወዳል፤ ወይም ወደ አንዱ ይጠጋል ሁለተኛውንም ይንቃል፤ ለእግዚአብሔርና ለገንዘብ መገዛት አትችሉም።
“No one can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other; or else he will be devoted to one and despise the other. You can’t serve both God and Mammon.
ስለዚህ እላችኋለሁ፥ ስለ ነፍሳችሁ በምትበሉትና በምትጠጡት፥ ወይም ስለ ሰውነታችሁ በምትለብሱት አትጨነቁ፤ ነፍስ ከመብል ሰውነትም ከልብስ አይበልጥምን?
Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body, what you will wear. Isn’t life more than food, and the body more than clothing?
ወደ ሰማይ ወፎች ተመልከቱ፤ አይዘሩም አያጭዱምም በጎተራም አይከቱም፥ የሰማዩ አባታችሁም ይመግባቸዋል፤ እናንተ ከእነርሱ እጅግ አትበልጡምን?
See the birds of the sky, that they don’t sow, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns. Your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren’t you of much more value than they?
ከእናንተ ተጨንቆ በቁመቱ ላይ አንድ ክንድ መጨመር የሚችል ማን ነው?
“Which of you, by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan?
ስለ ልብስስ ስለ ምን ትጨነቃላችሁ? የሜዳ አበቦች እንዴት እንዲያድጉ ልብ አድርጋችሁ ተመልከቱ፤
Why are you anxious about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin,
አይደክሙም አይፈትሉምም፤ ነገር ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ ሰሎሞንስ እንኳ በክብሩ ሁሉ ከነዚህ እንደ አንዱ አልለበሰም።
yet I tell you that even Solomon in all his glory was not dressed like one of these.
እግዚአብሔር ግን ዛሬ ያለውን ነገም ወደ እቶን የሚጣለውን የሜዳን ሣር እንዲህ የሚያለብሰው ከሆነ፥ እናንተ እምነት የጎደላችሁ፥ እናንተንማ ይልቁን እንዴት?
But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today exists, and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, won’t he much more clothe you, you of little faith?
እንግዲህ። ምን እንበላለን? ምንስ እንጠጣለን? ምንስ እንለብሳለን? ብላችሁ አትጨነቁ፤
“Therefore don’t be anxious, saying, ‘What will we eat?’, ‘What will we drink?’ or, ‘With what will we be clothed?’
ይህንስ ሁሉ አሕዛብ ይፈልጋሉ፤ ይህ ሁሉ እንዲያስፈልጋችሁ የሰማዩ አባታችሁ ያውቃልና።
For the Gentiles seek after all these things; for your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things.
ነገር ግን አስቀድማችሁ የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት ጽድቁንም ፈልጉ፥ ይህም ሁሉ ይጨመርላችኋል።
But seek first God’s Kingdom, and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.
ነገ ለራሱ ይጨነቃልና ለነገ አትጨነቁ፤ ለቀኑ ክፋቱ ይበቃዋል።
Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.
HEB 6:1-13: ስለዚህ የክርስቶስን ነገር መጀመሪያ የሚናገረውን ቃል ትተን ወደ ፍጻሜ እንሂድ፤ መሠረትን ደግመን አንመሥርት፥ እርሱም ከሞተ ሥራ ንስሐና በእግዚአብሔር እምነት፥ ስለ ጥምቀቶችና እጆችንም ስለ መጫን ስለ ሙታንም ትንሣኤ ስለ ዘላለም ፍርድም ትምህርት ነው።
Therefore leaving the teaching of the first principles of Christ, let us press on to perfection—not laying again a foundation of repentance from dead works, of faith toward God,
of the teaching of baptisms, of laying on of hands, of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.
እግዚአብሔርም ቢፈቅድ ይህን እናደርጋለን።
This will we do, if God permits.
አንድ ጊዜ ብርሃን የበራላቸውን ሰማያዊውንም ስጦታ የቀመሱትን ከመንፈስ ቅዱስም ተካፋዮች ሆነው የነበሩትን
For concerning those who were once enlightened and tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Spirit,
መልካሙንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃልና ሊመጣ ያለውን የዓለም ኃይል የቀመሱትን
and tasted the good word of God, and the powers of the age to come,
በኋላም የካዱትን እንደገና ለንስሐ እነርሱን ማደስ የማይቻል ነው፤ ለራሳቸው የእግዚአብሔርን ልጅ ይሰቅሉታልና ያዋርዱትማልና።
and then fell away, it is impossible to renew them again to repentance; seeing they crucify the Son of God for themselves again, and put him to open shame.
ብዙ ጊዜ በእርስዋ ላይ የሚወርደውን ዝናብ የምትጠጣ መሬት፥ ለሚያርሱአትም ደግሞ የምትጠቅምን አትክልት የምታበቅል፥ ከእግዚአብሔር በረከትን ታገኛለችና፤
For the land which has drunk the rain that comes often on it, and produces a crop suitable for them for whose sake it is also tilled, receives blessing from God;
እሾህና ኵርንችትን ግን ብታወጣ፥ የተጣለች ናት ለመረገምም ትቀርባለች፥ መጨረሻዋም መቃጠል ነው።
but if it bears thorns and thistles, it is rejected and near being cursed, whose end is to be burned.
ስለ እናንተ ግን፥ ወዳጆች ሆይ፥ ምንም እንኳ እንዲሁ ብንናገር፥ አብልጦ የሚሻለውና ለመዳን የሚሆነው እንዲሆንላችሁ ተረድተናል።
But, beloved, we are persuaded of better things for you, and things that accompany salvation, even though we speak like this.
እግዚአብሔር፥ ቅዱሳንን ስላገለገላችሁ እስከ አሁንም ስለምታገለግሉአቸው፥ ያደረጋችሁትን ሥራ ለስሙም ያሳያችሁትን ፍቅር ይረሳ ዘንድ ዓመፀኛ አይደለምና።
For God is not unrighteous, so as to forget your work and the labor of love which you showed toward his name, in that you served the saints, and still do serve them.
በእምነትና በትዕግሥትም የተስፋውን ቃል የሚወርሱትን እንድትመስሉ እንጂ ዳተኞች እንዳትሆኑ፥ ተስፋ እስኪሞላ ድረስ እያንዳንዳችሁ ያን ትጋት እስከ መጨረሻ እንድታሳዩ እንመኛለን።
We desire that each one of you may show the same diligence to the fullness of hope even to the end,
that you won’t be sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and perseverance inherited the promises.
እግዚአብሔርም ለአብርሃም ተስፋ በሰጠው ጊዜ። በእውነት እየባረክሁ እባርክሃለሁ እያበዛሁም አበዛሃለሁ ብሎ፥ ከእርሱ በሚበልጥ በማንም ሊምል ስላልቻለ፥ በራሱ ማለ፤
For when God made a promise to Abraham, since he could swear by no one greater, he swore by himself,
JUD 1:9-14: የመላእክት አለቃ ሚካኤል ግን ከዲያብሎስ ጋር በተከራከረ ጊዜ ስለ ሙሴ ሥጋ ሲነጋገር። ጌታ ይገሥጽህ አለው እንጂ የስድብን ፍርድ ሊናገረው አልደፈረም።
But Michael, the archangel, when contending with the devil and arguing about the body of Moses, dared not bring against him an abusive condemnation, but said, “May the Lord rebuke you!”
እነዚህ ግን የማያውቁትን ሁሉ ይሳደባሉ፥ አእምሮም እንደሌላቸው እንስሶች በፍጥረታቸው በሚያውቁት ሁሉ በእርሱ ይጠፋሉ።
But these speak evil of whatever things they don’t know. They are destroyed in these things that they understand naturally, like the creatures without reason.
ወዮላቸው፥ በቃየል መንገድ ሄደዋልና ስለ ደመወዝም ለበለዓም ስሕተት ራሳቸውን አሳልፈው ሰጥተዋል በቆሬም መቃወም ጠፍተዋል።
Woe to them! For they went in the way of Cain, and ran riotously in the error of Balaam for hire, and perished in Korah’s rebellion.
እነዚህ ከእናንተ ጋር ሲጋበዙ በፍቅር ግብዣችሁ እንደ እድፍ ናቸው፤ እንደ እረኞች ያለ ፍርሃት ራሳቸውን ይጠብቃሉ፤ በነፋስ የተወሰዱ ውኃ የሌለባቸው ደመናዎች፥ ፍሬ የማያፈሩ ሁለት ጊዜ የሞቱ ከነሥራቸው የተነቀሉ በበጋ የደረቁ ዛፎች፥

These are hidden rocky reefs in your love feasts when they feast with you, shepherds who without fear feed themselves; clouds without water, carried along by winds; autumn trees without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;
የገዛ ነውራቸውን አረፋ እየደፈቁ ጨካኝ የባሕር ማዕበል፥ ድቅድቅ ጨለማ ለዘላለም የተጠበቀላቸው የሚንከራተቱ ከዋክብት ናቸው።
wild waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.

Therefore Jesus perceived that they wanted to ask him, and he said to them, “Do you inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me?’
እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ እናንተ ታለቅሳለችሁ ሙሾም ታወጣላችሁ፥ ዓለም ግን ደስ ይለዋል፤ እናንተም ታዝናላችሁ፥ ነገር ግን ኀዘናችሁ ወደ ደስታ ይለወጣል።
Most certainly I tell you, that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.
ሴት በምትወልድበት ጊዜ ወራትዋ ስለ ደረሰ ታዝናለች፤ ነገር ግን ሕፃን ከወለደች በኋላ፥ ሰው በዓለም ተወልዶአልና ስለ ደስታዋ መከራዋን ኋላ አታስበውም።

A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow, because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn’t remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world.
እንግዲህ እናንተ ደግሞ አሁን ታዝናላችሁ፤ ነገር ግን እንደ ገና አያችኋለሁ ልባችሁም ደስ ይለዋል፥ ደስታችሁንም የሚወስድባችሁ የለም።

For this we tell you by the word of the Lord, that we who are alive, who are left until the coming of the Lord, will in no way precede those who have fallen asleep.
ጌታ ራሱ በትእዛዝ በመላእክትም አለቃ ድምፅ በእግዚአብሔርም መለከት ከሰማይ ይወርዳልና፥ በክርስቶስም የሞቱ አስቀድመው ይነሣሉ፤

then we who are alive, who are left, will be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air. So we will be with the Lord forever.

Therefore comfort one another with these words.

But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.
ቃሉን የሚሰማ የማያደርገውም ቢኖር የተፈጥሮ ፊቱን በመስተዋት የሚያይን ሰው ይመስላል፤
For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror;
ራሱን አይቶ ይሄዳልና፥ ወዲያውም እንደ ምን እንደ ሆነ ይረሳል።
for he sees himself, and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.

If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this man’s religion is worthless.
ንጹሕ የሆነ ነውርም የሌለበት አምልኮ በእግዚአብሔር አብ ዘንድ ይህ ነው፤ ወላጆች የሌላቸውን ልጆች ባልቴቶችንም በመከራቸው መጠየቅ፥ በዓለምም ከሚገኝ እድፍ ሰውነቱን መጠበቅ ነው።
Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.

Now on the next day as they were on their journey, and got close to the city, Peter went up on the housetop to pray at about noon.

He saw heaven opened and a certain container descending to him, like a great sheet let down by four corners on the earth,
በዚያውም አራት እግር ያላቸው ሁሉ አራዊትም በምድርም የሚንቀሳቀሱት የሰማይ ወፎችም ነበሩበት።
in which were all kinds of four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, reptiles, and birds of the sky.
ጴጥሮስ ሆይ፥ ተነሣና አርደህ ብላ የሚልም ድምፅ ወደ እርሱ መጣ።
A voice came to him, “Rise, Peter, kill and eat!”

A voice came to him again the second time, “What God has cleansed, you must not call unclean.”
ይህም ሦስት ጊዜ ሆነ፥ ወዲያውም ዕቃው ወደ ሰማይ ተወሰደ።
This was done three times, and immediately the vessel was received up into heaven.

Now while Peter was very perplexed in himself what the vision which he had seen might mean, behold, the men who were sent by Cornelius, having made inquiry for Simon’s house, stood before the gate,

Don’t deliver me over to the desire of my adversaries, for false witnesses have risen up against me, such as breathe out cruelty.
የእግዚአብሔርን ቸርነት በሕያዋን ምድር አይ ዘንድ አምናለሁ።
I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of Yahweh in the land of the living.
PSA 86:1-m: His foundation is in the holy mountains.
ከያዕቆብ ድንኳኖች ይልቅ፥ እግዚአብሔር የጽዮንን ደጆች ይወድዳቸዋል።
Yahweh loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

ተግሣጹን ተቀበሉ ጌታ እንዳይቈጣ እናንተም በመንገድ እንዳትጠፉ፥ ቍጣው ፈጥና ትነድዳለችና። በእርሱ የታመኑ ሁሉ የተመሰገኑ ናቸው።
Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all those who take refuge in him.
LUK 11:1-14: እርሱም በአንድ ስፍራ ይጸልይ ነበር፥ በጨረሰም ጊዜ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ አንዱ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ዮሐንስ ደቀ መዛሙርቱን እንዳስተማረ እንጸልይ ዘንድ አስተምረን አለው።
When he finished praying in a certain place, one of his disciples said to him, “Lord, teach us to pray, just as John also taught his disciples.”
አላቸውም። ስትጸልዩ እንዲህ በሉ። በሰማያት የምትኖር አባታችን ሆይ፤ ስምህ ይቀደስ፤ መንግሥትህ ትምጣ፤ ፈቃድህ በሰማይ እንደ ሆነች እንዲሁ በምድር ትሁን፤
He said to them, “When you pray, say, ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy. May your Kingdom come. May your will be done on earth, as it is in heaven.
የዕለት እንጀራችንን ዕለት ዕለት ስጠን፤
Give us day by day our daily bread.
ኃጢአታችንንም ይቅር በለን፥ እኛ ደግሞ የበደሉንን ሁሉ ይቅር ብለናልና፤ ከክፉ አድነን እንጂ ወደ ፈተና አታግባን።
Forgive us our sins, for we ourselves also forgive everyone who is indebted to us. Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.’”
እንዲህም አላቸው። ከእናንተ ማናቸውም ወዳጅ ያለው፥ በእኩል ሌሊትስ ወደ እርሱ ሄዶ። ወዳጄ ሆይ፥ ሦስት እንጀራ አበድረኝ፥
He said to them, “Which of you, if you go to a friend at midnight, and tell him, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,
አንድ ወዳጄ ከመንገድ ወደ እኔ መጥቶ የማቀርብለት የለኝምና ይላልን?
for a friend of mine has come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him,’
ያም ከውስጥ መልሶ። አታድክመኝ፤ አሁን ደጁ ተቈልፎአል ልጆቼም ከእኔ ጋር በአልጋ ላይ አሉ፤ ተነሥቼ ልሰጥህ አልችልም ይላልን?
and he from within will answer and say, ‘Don’t bother me. The door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed. I can’t get up and give it to you’?
እላችኋለሁ፥ ወዳጅ ስለ ሆነ ተነሥቶ ባይሰጠው እንኳ፥ ስለ ንዝነዛው ተነስቶ የሚፈልገውን ሁሉ ይሰጠዋል።
I tell you, although he will not rise and give it to him because he is his friend, yet because of his persistence, he will get up and give him as many as he needs.
እኔም እላችኋለሁ። ለምኑ፥ ይሰጣችሁማል፤ ፈልጉ፥ ታገኙማላችሁ፤ መዝጊያን አንኳኩ፥ ይከፍትላችሁማል።
“I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given you. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and it will be opened to you.
የሚለምን ሁሉ ይቀበላልና፥ የሚፈልግም ያገኛል፥ መዝጊያውንም ለሚያንኳኳው ይከፈትለታል።
For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
አባት ከሆናችሁ ከእናንተ ከማንኛችሁም ልጁ እንጀራ ቢለምነው፥ እርሱም ድንጋይ ይሰጠዋልን? ዓሣ ደግሞ ቢለምነው በዓሣ ፋንታ እባብ ይሰጠዋልን?
“Which of you fathers, if your son asks for bread, will give him a stone? Or if he asks for a fish, he won’t give him a snake instead of a fish, will he?
ወይስ እንቍላል ቢለምነው ጊንጥ ይሰጠዋልን?
Or if he asks for an egg, he won’t give him a scorpion, will he?
እንኪያስ እናንተ ክፉዎች ስትሆኑ ለልጆቻችሁ መልካም ስጦታ መስጠት ካወቃችሁ፥ በሰማይ ያለው አባት ለሚለምኑት እንዴት አብልጦ መንፈስ ቅዱስን ይሰጣቸው?
If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him?”
ዲዳውንም ጋኔን ያወጣ ነበር፤ ጋኔኑም ከወጣ በኋላ ዲዳው ተናገረ ሕዝቡም ተደነቁ፤
He was casting out a demon, and it was mute. When the demon had gone out, the mute man spoke; and the multitudes marveled.
PSA 39:2-m: ከጥፋት ጕድጓድ ከረግረግም ጭቃ አወጣኝ፥ እግሮቼንም በድንጋይ ላይ አቆማቸው፥ አረማመዴንም አጸና።
He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand.
አዲስ ዝማሬን ለአምላካችን ምስጋና በአፌ ጨመረ፤ ብዙዎች ያያሉ ይፈሩማል፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ይታመናሉ።
He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in Yahweh.
LUK 11:33-37: መብራትንም አብርቶ በስውር ወይም በእንቅብ በታች የሚያኖረው የለም፥ የሚገቡ ሰዎች ብርሃኑን እንዲያዩ በመቅረዝ ላይ ያኖረዋል እንጂ።
“No one, when he has lit a lamp, puts it in a cellar or under a basket, but on a stand, that those who come in may see the light.
የሰውነትህ መብራት ዓይንህ ናት። ዓይንህ ጤናማ በሆነች ጊዜ ሰውነትህ ሁሉ ደግሞ ብሩህ ይሆናል። ዓይንህ ታማሚ በሆነች ጊዜ ግን ሰውነትህ ደግሞ የጨለመ ይሆናል።
The lamp of the body is the eye. Therefore when your eye is good, your whole body is also full of light; but when it is evil, your body also is full of darkness.
እንግዲህ በአንተ ያለው ብርሃን ጨለማ እንዳይሆን ተመልከት።
Therefore see whether the light that is in you isn’t darkness.
እንግዲህ ሰውነትህ ሁሉ የጨለማ ቍራጭ የሌለበት ብሩህ ቢሆን፥ መብራት በደመቀ ብርሃን እንደሚያበራልህ በጭራሽ ብሩህ ይሆናል።
If therefore your whole body is full of light, having no part dark, it will be wholly full of light, as when the lamp with its bright shining gives you light.”
ይህንንም ሲናገር አንድ ፈሪሳዊ ከእርሱ ጋር ምሳ ይበላ ዘንድ ለመነው ገብቶም ተቀመጠ።
Now as he spoke, a certain Pharisee asked him to dine with him. He went in, and sat at the table.
2CO 7:13-EOC: በመጽናናታችንም ስለ ቲቶ ደስታ አብልጦ ደስ አለን፥ መንፈሱ በሁላችሁ ዐርፎአልና፤
Therefore we have been comforted. In our comfort we rejoiced the more exceedingly for the joy of Titus, because his spirit has been refreshed by you all.
ለእርሱ በምንም ስለ እናንተ የተመካሁ እንደ ሆነ አላፈርሁምና፥ ነገር ግን ሁሉን ለእናንተ በእውነት እንደ ተናገርን፥ እንደዚህ ደግሞ ትምክህታችን በቲቶ ፊት እውነት ሆነ።
For if in anything I have boasted to him on your behalf, I was not disappointed. But as we spoke all things to you in truth, so our glorying also which I made before Titus was found to be truth.
ስለዚህም በፍርሃትና በመንቀጥቀጥ እንዴት እንደተቀበላችሁት፥ የሁላችሁን መታዘዝ እያሰበ ፍቅሩ በእናንተ ላይ እጅግ በዝቶአል።
His affection is more abundantly toward you, while he remembers all of your obedience, how with fear and trembling you received him.
I rejoice that in everything I am confident concerning you.
JUD 1:17-EOC: እናንተ ግን፥ ወዳጆች ሆይ፥ በጌታችን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ሐዋርያት ቀድሞ የተነገረውን ቃል አስቡ፤
But you, beloved, remember the words which have been spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
እነርሱ። በመጨረሻው ዘመን በኃጢአተኝነት እንደ ገዛ ምኞታቸው እየሄዱ ዘባቾች ይሆናሉ ብለዋችኋልና።
They said to you that “In the last time there will be mockers, walking after their own ungodly lusts.”
እነዚህ የሚያለያዩ ሥጋውያንም የሆኑ መንፈስም የሌላቸው ሰዎች ናቸው።
These are they who cause divisions, and are sensual, not having the Spirit.
እናንተ ግን፥ ወዳጆች ሆይ፥ ከሁሉ ይልቅ በተቀደሰ ሃይማኖታችሁ ራሳችሁን ለማነጽ እየተጋችሁ በመንፈስ ቅዱስም እየጸለያችሁ፥
But you, beloved, keep building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit.
ወደ ዘላለም ሕይወት የሚወስደውን የጌታችንን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን ምሕረት ስትጠባበቁ በእግዚአብሔር ፍቅር ራሳችሁን ጠብቁ።
Keep yourselves in God’s love, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to eternal life.
አንዳንዶች ተከራካሪዎችንም ውቀሱ፥ አንዳንዶችንም ከእሳት ነጥቃችሁ አድኑ፥
On some have compassion, making a distinction,
አንዳንዶችንም በሥጋ የረከሰውን ልብስ እንኳ እየጠላችሁ በፍርሃት ማሩ።
and some save, snatching them out of the fire with fear, hating even the clothing stained by the flesh.
ሳትሰናከሉም እንዲጠብቃችሁ፥ በክብሩም ፊት በደስታ ነውር የሌላችሁ አድርጎ እንዲያቆማችሁ ለሚችለው
Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in great joy,
ብቻውን ለሆነ አምላክና መድኃኒታችን ከዘመን ሁሉ በፊት አሁንም እስከ ዘላለምም ድረስ በጌታችን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ክብርና ግርማ ኃይልም ሥልጣንም ይሁን፤ አሜን።
to God our Savior, who alone is wise, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and forever. Amen.
ACT 5:12-17: በሐዋርያትም እጅ ብዙ ምልክትና ድንቅ በሕዝብ መካከል ይደረግ ነበር፤ ሁሉም በአንድ ልብ ሆነው በሰሎሞን ደጅ መመላለሻ ነበሩ።
By the hands of the apostles many signs and wonders were done among the people. They were all with one accord in Solomon’s porch.
ከሌሎችም አንድ ስንኳ ሊተባበራቸው የሚደፍር አልነበረም፥
None of the rest dared to join them, however the people honored them.
ሕዝቡ ግን ያከብሩአቸው ነበር፤ የሚያምኑትም ከፊት ይልቅ ለጌታ ይጨመሩለት ነበር፤ ወንዶችና ሴቶችም ብዙ ነበሩ።
More believers were added to the Lord, multitudes of both men and women.
ስለዚህም ጴጥሮስ ሲያልፍ ጥላውም ቢሆን ከእነርሱ አንዱን ይጋርድ ዘንድ ድውያንን ወደ አደባባይ አውጥተው በአልጋና በወሰካ ያኖሩአቸው ነበር።

ይህን ተናገረ፤ ከዚህም በኋላ። ወዳጃችን አልዓዛር ተኝቶአል፤ ነገር ግን ከእንቅልፉ ላስነሣው እሄዳለሁ አላቸው።

Praise Yahweh, all you armies of his, you servants of his, who do his pleasure.

Into whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace be to this house.’
በዚያም የሰላም ልጅ ቢኖር፥ ሰላማችሁ ያድርበታል፤ አለዚያም ይመለስላችኋል።
If a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you.
በዚያም ቤት ከእነርሱ ዘንድ ካለው እየበላችሁና እየጠጣችሁ ተቀመጡ፤ ለሠራተኛ ደመወዙ ይገባዋልና። ከቤት ወደ ቤት አትተላለፉ።
Remain in that same house, eating and drinking the things they give, for the laborer is worthy of his wages. Don’t go from house to house.
ወደምትገቡባትም ከተማ ሁሉ ቢቀበሉአችሁ፥ ያቀረቡላችሁን ብሉ፤
Into whatever city you enter, and they receive you, eat the things that are set before you.
በእርስዋም ያሉትን ድውዮችን ፈውሱና። የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ወደ እናንተ ቀረበች በሉአቸው።
Heal the sick who are therein, and tell them, ‘God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’
ነገር ግን ወደምትገቡባት ከተማ ሁሉ ባይቀበሉአችሁ፥ ወደ አደባባይዋ ወጥታችሁ።
But into whatever city you enter, and they don’t receive you, go out into its streets and say,
ከከተማችሁ የተጣበቀብንን ትቢያ እንኳን እናራግፍላችኋለን፤ የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ግን ወደ እናንተ እንደ ቀረበች ይህን እወቁ በሉ።
‘Even the dust from your city that clings to us, we wipe off against you. Nevertheless know this, that God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’
እላችኋለሁ፥ በዚያን ቀን ከዚያች ከተማ ይልቅ ለሰዶም ይቀልላታል።
I tell you, it will be more tolerable in that day for Sodom than for that city.
GAL 2:1-14: ከዚያ ወዲያ ከአሥራ አራት ዓመት በኋላ ከበርናባስ ጋር ቲቶን ደግሞ ይዤ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ሁለተኛ ወጣሁ፤
Then after a period of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with me.
እንደ ተገለጠልኝም ወጣሁ፤ ምናልባትም በከንቱ እንዳልሮጥ ወይም በከንቱ ሮጬ እንዳልሆን በአሕዛብ መካከል የምሰብከውን ወንጌል አስታወቅኋቸው፤ ዋኖች ግን መስለው ለሚታዩ ለብቻቸው አስታወቅኋቸው።
I went up by revelation, and I laid before them the Good News which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately before those who were respected, for fear that I might be running, or had run, in vain.
ነገር ግን ከእኔ ጋር የነበረ ቲቶ እንኳ የግሪክ ሰው ሲሆን ይገረዝ ዘንድ ግድ አላሉትም፤
But not even Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.
ነገር ግን ባሪያዎች ሊያደርጉን በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ያለንን አርነታችንን ይሰልሉ ዘንድ ሾልከው በስውር ስለ ገቡ ስለ ሐሰተኞች ወንድሞች ነበረ።
This was because of the false brothers secretly brought in, who stole in to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage;
የወንጌልም እውነት በእናንተ ዘንድ ጸንቶ እንዲኖር ለአንድ ሰዓት እንኳ ለቅቀን አልተገዛንላቸውም።
to whom we gave no place in the way of subjection, not for an hour, that the truth of the Good News might continue with you.
አለቆች የመሰሉት ግን፥ በፊት ማን እንደ ነበሩ አይገደኝም፤ እግዚአብሔር የሰውን ፊት አይቶ አያደላም፤ አለቆች የመሰሉት አንዳች እንኳ አልጨመሩልኝምና፥
But from those who were reputed to be important (whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God doesn’t show partiality to man)—they, I say, who were respected imparted nothing to me,
ተመልሰው ግን ጴጥሮስ ለተገረዙት የሆነው ወንጌል አደራ እንደ ተሰጠው እንዲሁ ለእኔ ላልተገረዙት የሆነው ወንጌል አደራ እንደ ተሰጠኝ አዩ፤
but to the contrary, when they saw that I had been entrusted with the Good News for the uncircumcised, even as Peter with the Good News for the circumcised
ለተገረዙት ሐዋርያ እንዲሆን ለጴጥሮስ የሠራለት፥ ለእኔ ደግሞ ለአሕዛብ ሐዋርያ እንድሆን ሠርቶአልና።
(for he who worked through Peter in the apostleship with the circumcised also worked through me with the Gentiles);
ደግሞ የተሰጠኝን ጸጋ አውቀው፥ አዕማድ መስለው የሚታዩ ያዕቆብና ኬፋ ዮሐንስም እኛ ወደ አሕዛብ እነርሱም ወደ ተገረዙት ይሄዱ ዘንድ ለእኔና ለበርናባስ ቀኝ እጃቸውን ሰጡን፤

and when they perceived the grace that was given to me, James and Cephas and John, they who were reputed to be pillars, gave to me and Barnabas the right hand of fellowship, that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcision.
ድሆችን እናስብ ዘንድ ብቻ ለመኑን፥ ይህንም ደግሞ ላደርግ ተጋሁ።
They only asked us to remember the poor—which very thing I was also zealous to do.
ነገር ግን ኬፋ ወደ አንጾኪያ በመጣ ጊዜ ፊት ለፊት ተቃወምሁት፥ ይፈረድበት ዘንድ ይገባ ነበርና።
But when Peter came to Antioch, I resisted him to his face, because he stood condemned.
አንዳንድ ከያዕቆብ ዘንድ ሳይመጡ ከአሕዛብ ጋር አብሮ ይበላ ነበርና፤ በመጡ ጊዜ ግን ከተገረዙት ወገን ያሉትን ፈርቶ ያፈገፍግ ነበርና ከእነርሱ ተለየ።
For before some people came from James, he ate with the Gentiles. But when they came, he drew back and separated himself, fearing those who were of the circumcision.
የቀሩትም አይሁድ ደግሞ፥ በርናባስ ስንኳ በግብዝነታቸው እስከ ተሳበ ድረስ፥ ከእርሱ ጋር አብረው ግብዞች ሆኑ።
And the rest of the Jews joined him in his hypocrisy; so that even Barnabas was carried away with their hypocrisy.
ነገር ግን እንደ ወንጌል እውነት በቅንነት እንዳልሄዱ ባየሁ ጊዜ በሁሉ ፊት ኬፋን። አንተ አይሁዳዊ ሳለህ በአይሁድ ኑሮ ያይደለ በአሕዛብ ኑሮ ብትኖር፥ አሕዛብ በአይሁድ ኑሮ ሊኖሩ እንዴት ግድ አልሃቸው? አልሁት።

But when I saw that they didn’t walk uprightly according to the truth of the Good News, I said to Peter before them all, “If you, being a Jew, live as the Gentiles do, and not as the Jews do, why do you compel the Gentiles to live as the Jews do?
COL 4:1-EOC: ጌቶች ሆይ፥ እናንተ ደግሞ በሰማይ ጌታ እንዳላችሁ ታውቃላችሁና ለባሪያዎቻችሁ በጽድቅና በቅንነት አድርጉላቸው።
Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.
ከማመስገን ጋር በጸሎት እየነቃችሁ ለእርሱ ትጉ።
Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching therein with thanksgiving;
በዚያን ጊዜም ስለ እርሱ ደግሞ የታሰርሁበትን የክርስቶስን ምሥጢር እንድንነግር እግዚአብሔር የቃሉን ደጅ ይከፍትልን ዘንድ ስለ እኛ ደግሞ ጸልዩ።
praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds;
ልናገር እንደሚገባኝ ያህል እገልጠው ዘንድ ጸልዩልኝ።
that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.
ዘመኑን እየዋጃችሁ፥ በውጭ ባሉቱ ዘንድ በጥበብ ተመላለሱ።
Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.
ለእያንዳንዱ እንዴት እንድትመልሱ እንደሚገባችሁ ታውቁ ዘንድ ንግግራችሁ ሁልጊዜ፥ በጨው እንደ ተቀመመ፥ በጸጋ ይሁን።
Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.
የተወደደ ወንድምና የታመነ አገልጋይ በጌታም አብሮኝ ባሪያ የሆነ ቲኪቆስ ኑሮዬን ሁሉ ያስታውቃችኋል።
All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.
ወሬያችንን እንድታውቁና ልባችሁን እንዲያጽናና፥ ከእናንተ ከሆነውና ከታመነው ከተወደደውም ወንድም ከአናሲሞስ ጋር ወደ እናንተ የምልከው ስለዚህ ምክንያት ነው። የዚህን ስፍራ ወሬ ሁሉ ያስታውቁአችኋል።
I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts,
together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.
ከተገረዙት ወገን ያሉት፥ አብሮ ከእኔ ጋር የታሰረ አርስጥሮኮስ የበርናባስም የወንድሙ ልጅ ማርቆስ ኢዮስጦስም የተባለ ኢያሱ ሰላምታ ያቀርቡላችኋል። ስለ ማርቆስ። ወደ እናንተ ቢመጣ፥ ተቀበሉት የሚል ትእዛዝ ተቀበላችሁ። በእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ከእኔ ጋር አብረው የሚሠሩት እነዚህ ብቻ ናቸው፥ እኔንም አጽናንተውኛል።
Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark, the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received commandments, “if he comes to you, receive him”),
and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for God’s Kingdom who are of the circumcision, men who have been a comfort to me.
ከእናንተ የሆነ የክርስቶስ ባሪያ ኤጳፍራ ሰላምታ ያቀርብላችኋል። በእግዚአብሔር ፈቃድ ሁሉ ተረድታችሁና ፍጹማን ሆናችሁ እንድትቆሙ፥ ሁልጊዜ ስለ እናንተ በጸሎቱ ይጋደላል።
Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.
ስለ እናንተ በሎዶቅያም በኢያራ ከተማም ስላሉቱ እጅግ እንዲቀና እመሰክርለታለሁና።
For I testify about him, that he has great zeal for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.
የተወደደው ባለ መድኃኒቱ ሉቃስ ዴማስም ሰላምታ ያቀርቡላችኋል።
Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas greet you.
በሎዶቅያ ላሉቱ ወንድሞችና ለንምፉን በቤቱም ላለች ቤተ ክርስቲያን ሰላምታ አቅርቡልን።
Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the assembly that is in his house.
ይህችም መልእክት በእናንተ ዘንድ ከተነበበች በኋላ፥ በሎዶቅያ ሰዎች ማኅበር ደግሞ እንድትነበብ አድርጉ። ከሎዶቅያም የምትገኘውን መልእክት እናንተ ደግሞ አንብቡ።
When this letter has been read among you, cause it to be read also in the assembly of the Laodiceans; and that you also read the letter from Laodicea.

and he will reign over the house of Jacob forever. There will be no end to his Kingdom.”
ማርያምም መልአኩን። ወንድ ስለማላውቅ ይህ እንዴት ይሆናል? አለችው።
Mary said to the angel, “How can this be, seeing I am a virgin?”
መልአኩም መልሶ እንዲህ አላት። መንፈስ ቅዱስ በአንቺ ላይ ይመጣል፥ የልዑልም ኃይል ይጸልልሻል ስለዚህ ደግሞ ከአንቺ የሚወለደው ቅዱስ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ይባላል።
The angel answered her, “The Holy Spirit will come on you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. Therefore also the holy one who is born from you will be called the Son of God.
እነሆም ዘመድሽ ኤልሳቤጥ፥ እርስዋ ደግሞ በእርጅናዋ ወንድ ልጅ ፀንሳለች፥ ለእርስዋም መካን ትባል ለነበረችው ይህ ስድስተኛ ወር ነው፤
Behold, Elizabeth, your relative, also has conceived a son in her old age; and this is the sixth month with her who was called barren.
ለእግዚአብሔር የሚሳነው ነገር የለምና።
For nothing spoken by God is impossible.”
ማርያምም። እነሆኝ የጌታ ባሪያ እንደ ቃልህ ይሁንልኝ አለች። መልአኩም ከእርስዋ ሄደ።
Mary said, “Behold, the servant of the Lord; let it be done to me according to your word.” The angel departed from her.
ማርያምም በዚያ ወራት ተነሥታ ወደ ተራራማው አገር ወደ ይሁዳ ከተማ ፈጥና ወጣች፥
Mary arose in those days and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah,
ወደ ዘካርያስም ቤት ገብታ ኤልሳቤጥን ተሳለመቻት።
and entered into the house of Zacharias and greeted Elizabeth.
ኤልሳቤጥም የማርያምን ሰላምታ በሰማች ጊዜ ፅንሱ በማኅፀንዋ ውስጥ ዘለለ፤ በኤልሳቤጥም መንፈስ ቅዱስ ሞላባት፥
When Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting, the baby leaped in her womb, and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.
በታላቅ ድምፅም ጮኻ እንዲህ አለች። አንቺ ከሴቶች መካከል የተባረክሽ ነሽ፥ የማኅፀንሽም ፍሬ የተባረከ ነው።
She called out with a loud voice, and said, “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!
የጌታዬ እናት ወደ እኔ ትመጣ ዘንድ እንዴት ይሆንልኛል?
Why am I so favored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
እነሆ፥ የሰላምታሽ ድምጽ በጆሮዬ በመጣ ጊዜ ፅንሱ በማኅፀኔ በደስታ ዘሎአልና።
For behold, when the voice of your greeting came into my ears, the baby leaped in my womb for joy!
ከጌታ፤ የተነገረላት ቃል ይፈጸማልና ያመነች ብፅዕት ናት።
Blessed is she who believed, for there will be a fulfillment of the things which have been spoken to her from the Lord!”
ማርያምም እንዲህ አለች።
Mary said, “My soul magnifies the Lord.
ነፍሴ ጌታን ታከብረዋለች፥ መንፈሴም በአምላኬ በመድኃኒቴ ሐሴት ታደርጋለች፤
My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,
የባሪያይቱን ውርደት ተመልክቶአልና። እነሆም፥ ከዛሬ ጀምሮ ትውልድ ሁሉ ብፅዕት ይሉኛል፤
for he has looked at the humble state of his servant. For behold, from now on, all generations will call me blessed.
ብርቱ የሆነ እርሱ በእኔ ታላቅ ሥራ አድርጎአልና፤ ስሙም ቅዱስ ነው።
For he who is mighty has done great things for me. Holy is his name.
ምሕረቱም ለሚፈሩት እስከ ትውልድና ትውልድ ይኖራል።
His mercy is for generations of generations on those who fear him.
በክንዱ ኃይል አድርጎአል፤ ትዕቢተኞችን በልባቸው አሳብ በትኖአል፤
He has shown strength with his arm. He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
ገዥዎችን ከዙፋናቸው አዋርዶአል፤ ትሑታንንም ከፍ አድርጎአል፤
He has put down princes from their thrones. And has exalted the lowly.
የተራቡትን በበጎ ነገር አጥግቦአል፤ ባለ ጠጎችንም ባዶአቸውን ሰዶአቸዋል።
He has filled the hungry with good things. He has sent the rich away empty.
ለአባቶቻችን እንደ ተናገረ፥ ለአብርሃምና ለዘሩ ለዘላለም ምሕረቱ ትዝ እያለው እስራኤልን ብላቴናውን ረድቶአል።
He has given help to Israel, his servant, that he might remember mercy,
As he spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and his offspring forever.”
ማርያምም ሦስት ወር የሚያህል በእርስዋ ዘንድ ተቀመጠች ወደ ቤትዋም ተመለሰች።
Mary stayed with her about three months, and then returned to her house.
የኤልሳቤጥም የመውለጃዋ ጊዜ ደረሰ፥ ወንድ ልጅም ወለደች።
Now the time that Elizabeth should give birth was fulfilled, and she gave birth to a son.
ROM 4:13-18: የዓለምም ወራሽ እንዲሆን ለአብርሃምና ለዘሩ የተሰጠው የተስፋ ቃል በእምነት ጽድቅ ነው እንጂ በሕግ አይደለም።
For the promise to Abraham and to his offspring that he should be heir of the world wasn’t through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.
ከሕግ የሆኑትስ ወራሾች ከሆኑ እምነት ከንቱ ሆኖአል የተስፋውም ቃል ተሽሮአል፤
For if those who are of the law are heirs, faith is made void, and the promise is made of no effect.
ሕጉ መቅሠፍትን ያደርጋልና፤ ነገር ግን ሕግ በሌለበት መተላለፍ የለም።
For the law produces wrath, for where there is no law, neither is there disobedience.
ስለዚህ ከሕግ ብቻ ሳይሆን ከአብርሃም እምነት ደግሞ ለሆነ ለዘሩ ሁሉ የተስፋው ቃል እንዲጸና እንደ ጸጋ ይሆን ዘንድ በእምነት ነው፤ እርሱም። ለብዙ አሕዛብ አባት አደረግሁህ ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ፥ ለሙታን ሕይወት በሚሰጥ የሌለውንም እንዳለ አድርጎ በሚጠራ ባመነበት በአምላክ ፊት የሁላችን አባት ነው።

For this cause it is of faith, that it may be according to grace, to the end that the promise may be sure to all the offspring, not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all.
As it is written, “I have made you a father of many nations.” This is in the presence of him whom he believed: God, who gives life to the dead, and calls the things that are not, as though they were.
ዘርህ እንዲሁ ሊሆን ነው እንደ ተባለ፥ ተስፋ ባልሆነው ጊዜ የብዙ አሕዛብ አባት እንዲሆን ተስፋ ይዞ አመነ።
Besides hope, Abraham in hope believed, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that which had been spoken, “So will your offspring be.”
1JN 4:1-9: ወዳጆች ሆይ፥ መንፈስን ሁሉ አትመኑ፥ ነገር ግን መናፍስት ከእግዚአብሔር ሆነው እንደ ሆነ መርምሩ፤ ብዙዎች ሐሰተኞች ነቢያት ወደ ዓለም ወጥተዋልና።
Beloved, don’t believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
የእግዚአብሔርን መንፈስ በዚህ ታውቃላችሁ፤ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ በሥጋ እንደ መጣ የሚታመን መንፈስ ሁሉ ከእግዚአብሔር ነው፥
By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit who confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God,
ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስም በሥጋ እንደ መጣ የማይታመን መንፈስ ሁሉ ከእግዚአብሔር አይደለም፤ ይህም የክርስቶስ ተቃዋሚው መንፈስ ነው፤ ይህም እንዲመጣ ሰምታችኋል፥ አሁንም እንኳ በዓለም አለ።

and every spirit who doesn’t confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is not of God, and this is the spirit of the Antichrist, of whom you have heard that it comes. Now it is in the world already.
ልጆች ሆይ፥ እናንተ ከእግዚአብሔር ናችሁ አሸንፋችኋቸውማል፥ በዓለም ካለው ይልቅ በእናንተ ያለው ታላቅ ነውና።
You are of God, little children, and have overcome them; because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.
እነርሱ ከዓለም ናቸው፤ ስለዚህ ከዓለም የሆነውን ይናገራሉ ዓለሙም ይሰማቸዋል።
They are of the world. Therefore they speak of the world, and the world hears them.
እኛ ከእግዚአብሔር ነን፤ እግዚአብሔርን የሚያውቅ ይሰማናል፤ ከእግዚአብሔር ያልሆነ አይሰማንም። የእውነትን መንፈስና የስሕተትን መንፈስ በዚህ እናውቃለን።
We are of God. He who knows God listens to us. He who is not of God doesn’t listen to us. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.

Beloved, let us love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God, and knows God.
ፍቅር የሌለው እግዚአብሔርን አያውቅም፥ እግዚአብሔር ፍቅር ነውና።
He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.
በዚህ የእግዚአብሔር ፍቅር በእኛ ዘንድ ተገለጠ፥ በእርሱ በኩል በሕይወት እንኖር ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር አንድ ልጁን ወደ ዓለም ልኮታልና።
By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his one and only Son into the world that we might live through him.

They shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba. Men shall pray for him continually. They shall bless him all day long.
በምድር ውስጥ በተራሮች ላይ መጠጊያ ይሆናል፤ ፍሬውም ከሊባኖስ ይልቅ ከፍ ከፍ ይላል፤ እንደ ምድር ሣር በከተማ ይበቅላል።
Abundance of grain shall be throughout the land. Its fruit sways like Lebanon. Let it flourish, thriving like the grass of the field.
PSA 71:10-m: የተርሴስና የደሴቶች ነገሥታት ስጦታን ያመጣሉ፤ የዓረብና የሳባ ነገሥታት እጅ መንሻን ያቀርባሉ።
The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
ነገሥታት ሁሉ ይሰግዱለታል። አሕዛብም ሁሉ ይገዙለታል።

አንዳንዶች ግን እልከኞች ሆነው በሕዝብ ፊት መንገዱን እየሰደቡ ባላመኑ ጊዜ፥ ከእነርሱ ርቆ ደቀ መዛሙርትን ለየ፥ ጢራኖስም በሚሉት በትምህርት ቤት ዕለት ዕለት ይነጋገር ነበር።
But when some were hardened and disobedient, speaking evil of the Way before the multitude, he departed from them, and separated the disciples, reasoning daily in the school of Tyrannus.
በእስያም የኖሩት ሁሉ አይሁድም የግሪክ ሰዎችም የጌታን ቃል እስኪሰሙ ድረስ ሁለት ዓመት ያህል እንዲህ ሆነ።
This continued for two years, so that all those who lived in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.
እግዚአብሔርም በጳውሎስ እጅ የሚያስገርም ተአምራት ያደርግ ነበር፤ ስለዚህም ከአካሉ ጨርቅ ወይም ልብስ ወደ ድውዮች ይወስዱ ነበር፥
God worked special miracles by the hands of Paul,
ደዌያቸውም ይለቃቸው ነበር ክፉዎች መናፍስትም ይወጡ ነበር።
so that even handkerchiefs or aprons were carried away from his body to the sick, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out.
አጋንንትንም እያወጡ ይዞሩ ከነበሩት አይሁድ አንዳንዶች። ጳውሎስ በሚሰብከው በኢየሱስ እናምላችኋለን እያሉ ክፉዎች መናፍስት ባሉባቸው ላይ የጌታን የኢየሱስን ስም ይጠሩባቸው ዘንድ ሞከሩ።
But some of the itinerant Jews, exorcists, took on themselves to invoke over those who had the evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, “We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preaches.”
የካህናትም አለቃ ለሆነ አስቄዋ ለሚሉት ለአንድ አይሁዳዊ ይህን ያደረጉ ሰባት ልጆች ነበሩት።
There were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, who did this.
ክፉው መንፈስ ግን መልሶ። ኢየሱስንስ አውቀዋለሁ ጳውሎስንም አውቀዋለሁ፤ እናንተሳ እነማን ናችሁ? አላቸው።
The evil spirit answered, “Jesus I know, and Paul I know, but who are you?”
ክፉው መንፈስም ያለበት ሰው ዘለለባቸው ቆስለውም ከዚያ ቤት ዕራቁታቸውን እስኪሸሹ ድረስ በረታባቸው አሸነፋቸውም።
The man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, overpowered them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.
ይህም በኤፌሶን በሚኖሩት ሁሉ በአይሁድና በግሪክ ሰዎች ዘንድ የታወቀ ሆነ፥ በሁላቸውም ላይ ፍርሃት ወደቀባቸው፥ የጌታም የኢየሱስ ስም ተከበረ፤
This became known to all, both Jews and Greeks, who lived at Ephesus. Fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.
አምነውም ከነበሩት እጅግ ሰዎች ያደረጉትን እየተናዘዙና እየተናገሩ ይመጡ ነበር።
Many also of those who had believed came, confessing, and declaring their deeds.
ከአስማተኞችም ብዙዎቹ መጽሐፋቸውን ሰብስበው በሰው ሁሉ ፊት አቃጠሉት፤ ዋጋውም ቢታሰብ አምሳ ሺህ ብር ሆኖ ተገኘ።
Many of those who practiced magical arts brought their books together and burned them in the sight of all. They counted their price, and found it to be fifty thousand pieces of silver.
እንዲህም የጌታ ቃል በኃይል ያድግና ያሸንፍ ነበር።
So the word of the Lord was growing and becoming mighty.
ይህም በተፈጸመ ጊዜ ጳውሎስ። ወደዚያ ደርሼ ሮሜን ደግሞ አይ ዘንድ ይገባኛል ብሎ በመቄዶንያና በአካይያ አልፎ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እንዲሄድ በመንፈስ አሰበ።
Now after these things had ended, Paul determined in the spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, “After I have been there, I must also see Rome.”
PSA 78:10-m: አሕዛብ፥ አምላካቸው ወዴት ነው? እንዳይሉ፥ የፈሰሰውን የባሪያዎችህን ደም በቀል በዓይኖቻችን ፊት አሕዛብ ያወቁ፤
Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?” Let it be known among the nations, before our eyes, that vengeance for your servants’ blood is being poured out.
የእስረኞች ጩኸት ወደ ፊትህ ይግባ፤ እንደ ክንድህም ታላቅነት ሊገደሉ የተፈረደባቸውን አድን።
Let the sighing of the prisoner come before you. According to the greatness of your power, preserve those who are sentenced to death.
MAT 2:1-13: ኢየሱስም በይሁዳ ቤተ ልሔም በንጉሡ በሄሮድስ ዘመን በተወለደ ጊዜ፥ እነሆ፥ ሰብአ ሰገል። የተወለደው የአይሁድ ንጉሥ ወዴት ነው? ኮከቡን በምሥራቅ አይተን ልንሰግድለት መጥተናልና እያሉ ከምሥራቅ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጡ።
Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of King Herod, behold, wise men from the east came to Jerusalem, saying,
“Where is he who is born King of the Jews? For we saw his star in the east, and have come to worship him.”
ንጉሡ ሄሮድስም ሰምቶ ደነገጠ፥ ኢየሩሳሌምም ሁሉ ከእርሱ ጋር፤
When King Herod heard it, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.
የካህናትንም አለቆች የሕዝቡንም ጻፎች ሁሉ ሰብስቦ ክርስቶስ ወዴት እንዲወለድ ጠየቃቸው።
Gathering together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he asked them where the Christ would be born.
እነርሱም። አንቺ ቤተ ልሔም፥ የይሁዳ ምድር፥ ከይሁዳ ገዢዎች ከቶ አታንሽም፤ ሕዝቤን እስራኤልን የሚጠብቅ መስፍን ከአንቺ ይወጣልና ተብሎ በነቢይ እንዲህ ተጽፎአልና በይሁዳ ቤተ ልሔም ነው አሉት።
They said to him, “In Bethlehem of Judea, for this is written through the prophet,
‘You Bethlehem, land of Judah, are in no way least among the princes of Judah: for out of you shall come a governor, who shall shepherd my people, Israel.’”
ከዚህ በኋላ ሄሮድስ ሰብአ ሰገልን በስውር ጠርቶ ኮከቡ የታየበትን ዘመን ከእነርሱ በጥንቃቄ ተረዳ፥
Then Herod secretly called the wise men, and learned from them exactly what time the star appeared.
ወደ ቤተ ልሔምም እነርሱን ሰድዶ። ሂዱ፥ ስለ ሕፃኑ በጥንቃቄ መርምሩ፤ ባገኛችሁትም ጊዜ እኔ ደግሞ መጥቼ እንድሰግድለት ንገሩኝ አላቸው።
He sent them to Bethlehem, and said, “Go and search diligently for the young child. When you have found him, bring me word, so that I also may come and worship him.”
እነርሱም ንጉሡን ሰምተው ሄዱ፤ እነሆም፥ በምሥራቅ ያዩት ኮከብ ሕፃኑ ባለበት ላይ መጥቶ እስኪቆም ድረስ ይመራቸው ነበር።
They, having heard the king, went their way; and behold, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, until it came and stood over where the young child was.
ኮከቡንም ባዩ ጊዜ በታላቅ ደስታ እጅግ ደስ አላቸው።
When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceedingly great joy.
ወደ ቤትም ገብተው ሕፃኑን ከእናቱ ከማርያም ጋር አዩት፥ ወድቀውም ሰገዱለት፥ ሣጥኖቻቸውንም ከፍተው እጅ መንሻ ወርቅና ዕጣን ከርቤም አቀረቡለት።
They came into the house and saw the young child with Mary, his mother, and they fell down and worshiped him. Opening their treasures, they offered to him gifts: gold, frankincense, and myrrh.
ወደ ሄሮድስም እንዳይመለሱ በሕልም ተረድተው በሌላ መንገድ ወደ አገራቸው ሄዱ።
Being warned in a dream that they shouldn’t return to Herod, they went back to their own country another way.
እነርሱም ከሄዱ በኋላ እነሆ፥ የጌታ መልአክ በሕልም ለዮሴፍ ታይቶ። ሄሮድስ ሕፃኑን ሊገድለው ይፈልገዋልና ተነሣ፥ ሕፃኑንና እናቱንም ይዘህ ወደ ግብፅ ሽሽ፥ እስክነግርህም ድረስ በዚያ ተቀመጥ አለው።

Now when they had departed, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream, saying, “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and stay there until I tell you, for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.”
